content.json:
## Microsoft Sentinel Health
Monitors data connectors, analytics rules, automation rules and playbooks using the **SentinelHealth** table.

**Prerequisite:** turn on auditing and health monitoring in Microsoft Sentinel settings. See [Turn on auditing and health monitoring](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/enable-monitoring) and the [SentinelHealth table reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/health-table-reference).

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.label: Resource types
parameters.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| distinct SentinelResourceType
| order by SentinelResourceType asc

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where SentinelResourceType in ({Resources})
| summarize Events = count() by Status
content.title: Health events by status

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where SentinelResourceType in ({Resources})
| summarize Events = count() by SentinelResourceType
content.title: Health events by resource type

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where SentinelResourceType in ({Resources})
| where Status in ("Failure", "Partial success")
| summarize Failures = count() by SentinelResourceType, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Failures and partial successes over time

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where SentinelResourceType in ({Resources})
| summarize Events = count() by SentinelResourceName
| top 25 by Events
content.title: Health events by resource name

content.json: Connector health is only logged for supported connectors (AWS, Dynamics 365, Office 365, Defender for Endpoint, Threat Intelligence TAXII/TIP, and Codeless Connector Framework connectors).

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where SentinelResourceType =~ "Data connector"
| where OperationName == "Data fetch status change"
| where Status in ("Success", "Failure")
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SentinelResourceName, SentinelResourceId
| where Status == "Failure"
| project TimeGenerated, SentinelResourceName, SentinelResourceKind, Reason, Description, ExtendedProperties
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Connectors whose latest status is Failure

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where SentinelResourceType =~ "Data connector"
| where OperationName == "Data fetch status change"
| where Status in ("Success", "Failure")
| order by SentinelResourceId asc, TimeGenerated desc
| extend PreviousStatus = next(Status), PreviousTime = next(TimeGenerated), PreviousId = next(SentinelResourceId)
| extend rn = row_number(1, prev(SentinelResourceId) != SentinelResourceId)
| where PreviousId == SentinelResourceId and PreviousStatus != Status
| extend Transition = strcat(PreviousStatus, " -> ", Status), IsCurrent = rn == 1
| project TimeGenerated, SentinelResourceName, SentinelResourceKind, Transition, IsCurrent, PreviousTime, Reason, Description
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Status changes in time range (IsCurrent = most recent event for that connector)

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where SentinelResourceType =~ "Data connector"
| where OperationName == "Data fetch failure summary"
| project TimeGenerated, SentinelResourceName, SentinelResourceKind, Status, Description, ExtendedProperties
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Data fetch failure summaries

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where SentinelResourceType =~ "Analytics rule"
| summarize Runs = count() by Status, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Scheduled and NRT rule runs over time

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where SentinelResourceType =~ "Analytics rule"
| where Status == "Failure"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Reason, Description), Failures = count() by SentinelResourceName, SentinelResourceKind
| project-rename LastFailure = TimeGenerated
| order by Failures desc
content.title: Failing analytics rules

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where SentinelResourceType =~ "Analytics rule"
| where Reason == "The analytics rule is disabled and was not executed."
| summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by SentinelResourceName, SentinelResourceKind
content.title: Auto-disabled analytics rules

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where SentinelResourceType =~ "Analytics rule"
| summarize Runs = count() by Status, Reason
| order by Runs desc
content.title: Runs by status and reason

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where OperationName == "Automation rule run"
| summarize Runs = count() by Status
content.title: Automation rule runs by status

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where OperationName == "Playbook was triggered"
| summarize Runs = count(), Failures = countif(Status == "Failure"), LastRun = max(TimeGenerated) by SentinelResourceName
| extend FailureRatePct = round(100.0 * Failures / Runs, 1)
| order by Failures desc
content.title: Playbook triggers (manual/API) by playbook

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where OperationName == "Automation rule run"
| where Status in ("Failure", "Partial success")
| extend IncidentNumber = tostring(ExtendedProperties.IncidentNumber), TriggeredOn = tostring(ExtendedProperties.TriggeredOn), ActionsSucceeded = toint(ExtendedProperties.ActionsTriggeredSuccessfully), TotalActions = toint(ExtendedProperties.TotalActions)
| project TimeGenerated, SentinelResourceName, Status, Reason, Description, IncidentNumber, TriggeredOn, ActionsSucceeded, TotalActions
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Failed or partially successful automation rule runs

content.json: Playbook *contents* aren't logged here, only whether the playbook launched. For step-level results, enable Logic Apps diagnostics and query AzureDiagnostics.

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where SentinelResourceType in ({Resources})
| summarize Events = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Statuses = make_set(Status) by SentinelResourceType, SentinelResourceKind, SentinelResourceName
| order by LastSeen desc
content.title: Resource inventory

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where SentinelResourceType in ({Resources})
| summarize Events = count() by OperationName
content.title: Events by operation name

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where SentinelResourceType in ({Resources})
| summarize Events = count() by SentinelResourceKind
content.title: Events by resource kind

content.query:
_SentinelHealth()
| where SentinelResourceType in ({Resources})
| summarize Events = count() by Description
| order by Events desc
content.title: Events by description
